scene_description: A smiling female teacher stands at a green chalkboard with math problems written on it. Several young students are raising their hands eagerly to answer a question in a classroom.

questions.question: What do you think the teacher will do next after she sees all those raised hands?
questions.evidence_hint: Imagine what happens next in the classroom.

questions.question: What do you think the teacher asked the kids just before they raised their hands?
questions.evidence_hint: Imagine what happened just before the picture.

questions.question: Have you ever raised your hand in class or at storytime to share something?
questions.evidence_hint: Think about a time you wanted to share an answer.

questions.question: What else could the teacher write on the board instead of numbers?
questions.evidence_hint: Imagine something different on the chalkboard.

questions.question: How do you think the kids feel when they really want the teacher to pick them?
questions.evidence_hint: Think about how you would feel with your hand up waiting to be chosen.
